description_en: Query the list of APNs supported by cloud connector instances.
description_zh: 查询云连接器实例支持的APN列表
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-apns --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --apn CMWAP --isp mobile --type Standard --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAPNs

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:  

Do not specify this parameter for the first query or when there is no subsequent query.  

If there is a subsequent query, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。

如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page when performing a paginated query. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default Value: 10.
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.  

You can obtain the region ID by invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html API.
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The carrier corresponding to the APN. Valid values:  

telecom: China Telecom.  

mobile: China Mobile.  

unicom: China Unicom.
parameters.help_zh:
APN对应的运营商。取值：

telecom：中国电信。

mobile：中国移动。

unicom：中国联通
parameters.name: isp

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the cloud connector instance. Different editions have different feature limitations and billing policies. Valid values:  

Basic: Basic Edition.  

Standard: Standard Edition.  

<props="china">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. If you need to create a Basic Edition instance, submit a ticket (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today) to request approval.</props>  

<props="intl">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. If you need to create a Basic Edition instance, submit a ticket (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex) to request approval.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的版本，不同版本有不同功能限制和计费策略。取值：

Basic：基础版。

Standard：标准版。

<props="china">云连接器实例默认创建标准版，如果需要创建基础版实例，请提交工单 (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today)申请。</props>

<props="intl">云连接器实例默认创建标准版，如果需要创建基础版实例，请提交工单 (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex)申请</props>
parameters.name: type

wildcardDomain: wildcard domain name.
FeatureList.description_zh:

wildcardDomain：泛域名

ZoneList.description_en:
The list of zones to which the APN belongs.  
You can filter the list of available vSwitches based on this zone list.
ZoneList.description_zh:
APN所属可用区列表。
根据可用区列表，可以过滤出可使用的交换机列表

MaxResults.description_en: Number of entries displayed per batch during paginated queries.
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:  
If NextToken is empty, there is no subsequent query.  
If NextToken has a return value, this value represents the token to start the next query.
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: Total number of entries in the list.
